workflow_runs.display_title: tui: queue follow-ups during manual /compact

head_commit.message:
tui: persist only started manual compact turns

Persist the manual /compact queue gate only after the compact turn has a concrete turn id. That keeps older replayed turn completions from clearing the gate early and prevents stale pre-start latches from surviving thread switches indefinitely.

Co-authored-by: Codex <noreply@openai.com>
